name: ProXIcons
summary: Open-source icon library with 1,500+ icons in regular, solid, outline, logo and duotone styles.
description: A free, lightweight icon set for modern UIs: 1,500+ pixel-perfect SVG icons with regular, solid, outline, logo, brand and duotone variants. Install via npm, CDN or manual download and use CSS classes or a web component; framework examples cover React, Vue and Angular, and an icon customizer with SVG/PNG export is on the roadmap.
contains: styles: regular, solid, outline, logo, brand, duotone
install via npm, CDN or manual download
CSS classes and web component with color, size, rotate, flip, border and animation attributes
framework examples for React, Vue and Angular
customizer with SVG/PNG export on the roadmap
